context: Tests the marginal-session check: ask or skip rather than write a near-empty file.

checklist.name: Brevity recognised
checklist.description: Identifies that the session has no meaningful work

checklist.name: No file written first
checklist.description: Does not write a context file before asking

checklist.name: Confirmation asked
checklist.description: Asks "Session appears brief. Save context anyway?"

checklist.name: Empty answer handled
checklist.description: If the question returns blank, falls back to a numbered text list and waits

checklist.name: No index change
checklist.description: Does not touch INDEX.md while waiting

checklist.name: No padded content
checklist.description: Does not invent decisions or tasks to fill the template

checklist.name: Reason given
checklist.description: Says why a save looks unnecessary

checklist.name: Save on yes
checklist.description: If the user confirms, writes a minimal file within budget

checklist.name: Skip on no
checklist.description: If the user declines, ends without writing
